meta.title: UP NEET PG-2026 Counselling (MD/MS/Diploma/DNB/MDS)
meta.authority: Directorate of Medical Education and Training, Uttar Pradesh, Lucknow
governmentOrders: Govt. Order No. I/1405837/2026 dated 23-07-2026 (reservation, security fee eligibility, resignation, PMHS weightage)

process.title: Register online
process.description: Registration is online only, on upneet.gov.in, using your NEET-PG roll number and the same email ID you used on the NBE portal. Your name, parents' names and date of birth are pulled from NBE and can't be changed. You add domicile, category, sub-category, in-service status and where you did MBBS. Fill the form yourself, not through any agent or third party.

process.title: Pay the registration fee
process.description: Pay ₹3,000 once. It covers rounds 1, 2 and 3 and is non-refundable.

process.title: Pay the security deposit
process.description: Pay the deposit tier that matches the colleges you want to choose (₹30,000 / ₹1,00,000 / ₹2,00,000). Without it you cannot fill choices.

process.title: Merit list is declared
process.description: MD/MS/Diploma merit includes in-service (PMHS) weightage. DNB and MDS merit uses All-India NEET rank.

process.title: Fill and lock choices
process.description: Fill as many college + course choices as you want, then lock them. Unlocked choices are not considered for allotment.

process.title: Seat allotment result
process.description: Seats are allotted on merit and your locked choices. Results appear on upneet.gov.in.

process.title: Download allotment letter
process.description: Download your allotment letter before reporting to the allotted college or nodal centre.

process.title: Take admission
process.description: Report with original documents and pay fees at the allotted government college or the designated nodal centre (for private colleges) by the due date.

listedHomeInstitutions.label: Institutions named in the brochure whose graduates can't take Government State Quota seats

inServiceLabel.label: On the list of in-service (PMHS) candidates provided by the Director General Health Services, Uttar Pradesh

rules.title: Qualified NEET-PG / NEET-MDS 2026
rules.explanation: You must have qualified NEET-PG 2026 (for MD/MS/Diploma/DNB) or NEET-MDS 2026 (for MDS).

rules.title: Internship deadline (MD/MS/Diploma/DNB)
rules.explanation: Your one-year compulsory rotatory internship must be completed on or before 30-09-2026.

rules.title: Internship deadline (MDS)
rules.explanation: Your one-year compulsory rotatory internship must be completed on or before 31-05-2026.

rules.title: MBBS/BDS from a UP college
rules.explanation: Graduates of UP government or private medical/dental colleges are eligible for Government State Quota seats and private college seats.

rules.title: MBBS/BDS from AMU, BHU, AIIMS Raebareli or AIIMS Gorakhpur
rules.explanation: Graduates of these institutions are not eligible for Government State Quota seats. They can only apply to private medical and dental colleges.

rules.title: MBBS/BDS from outside Uttar Pradesh
rules.explanation: Candidates who passed MBBS/BDS outside Uttar Pradesh can only apply to private medical and dental colleges.
rules.note: Interpretation: "outside of Uttar Pradesh" (p4) literally includes MBBS done abroad, so we apply private-only to FMGs. p5 separately makes FMGs eligible as per NBE Bulletin 4.10 without stating a sector limit. Confirm with DGME UP.

rules.title: Currently admitted through an earlier NEET-PG/MDS
rules.explanation: If you're presently admitted to a course on the basis of an earlier NEET-PG or NEET-MDS, you can't take part until you complete and pass that course.
rules.note: The profile question asks exactly this: presently admitted through an earlier year's NEET-PG/MDS. This year's seats and INI-CET seats don't count.

rules.title: In-service (PMHS) weightage
rules.explanation: NEET-qualified in-service PMHS doctors on the DG Health Services list get weightage in the MD/MS/Diploma merit list (not DNB). DNB and MDS merit uses All-India NEET rank, with no weightage.

rules.title: State quota DNB seats are for in-service only
rules.explanation: Only in-service (PMHS) candidates are eligible for state quota DNB seats.

rules.title: Foreign medical graduates
rules.explanation: FMGs must meet NBE Information Bulletin 2026 point 4.10: qualified the FMGE screening test, registered with NMC/MCI or a State Medical Council, and internship completed by 30-09-2026.

rules.title: Foreign nationals
rules.explanation: Foreign nationals must meet NBE Information Bulletin 2026 point 4.11: an NMC-recognised primary qualification and MHA security clearance where required. The NMC may grant temporary registration for the PG course, but only if you're registered in your own country and have an NOC from that country's medical council to do PG in India.

rules.title: Reserved category from another state
rules.explanation: Reserved category candidates from other states are treated as Unreserved (UR) in UP NEET PG/MDS counselling.
rules.note: Interpretation: the brochure says "reserved category candidates of other states" without defining it. We use domicile.

rules.title: PwD certificate from a designated centre
rules.explanation: The 5% PwD reservation applies to Government State Quota seats in government medical institutions. To claim it, get a disability certificate (21 benchmark disabilities, RPwD Act 2016, NMC norms) from one of the designated centres in Annexure-2. Certificates from any other hospital or board are not accepted.

conversion.when: During the 3rd round of state quota counselling, and only after candidates of the original category are exhausted.

rules.title: Category lists
rules.detail: SC/ST/OBC lists are as notified by the Government of Uttar Pradesh at the time of counselling.

rules.title: UP-format certificates only
rules.detail: Reservation certificates are valid only in the format prescribed by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and issued by a competent UP authority.

rules.title: Fresh EWS and OBC certificates
rules.detail: EWS and OBC certificates are valid only if issued on or after 01-04-2026.

rules.title: PwD certificates from designated centres only
rules.detail: PwD certificates from any other hospital or board are not accepted. See the list of designated disability centres.

registration.covers: Rounds 1, 2 and 3. The stray vacancy round needs a fresh registration and another ₹3,000. No chargeback of the registration fee is entertained.

rules.title: Deposit eligibility is set by a government order
rules.detail: Check which deposit tier you are eligible for under Govt. Order No. I/1405837/2026 dated 23-07-2026.

rules.title: Pay from your own or a family account
rules.detail: Use your own or a family member's bank account for the security fee. Any refund goes back to the same account.

rules.title: No deposit, no choice filling
rules.detail: If you don't pay the security fee you cannot fill choices.

rules.title: Refunds come after all rounds
rules.detail: Security money refunds for eligible candidates start only after all counselling rounds are complete.

rules.title: Private college tuition at admission
rules.detail: At admission to a private college, you pay the government-fixed tuition fee. Minority institutions charge the tuition fee prescribed by the college.

rules.title: Keep your receipts
rules.detail: Download your registration form, registration fee slip and security money receipt after paying.

choiceFilling.title: Log in with your roll number
choiceFilling.detail: Fill choices on upneet.gov.in with your NEET roll number and the password you created at registration. Don't share the password.

choiceFilling.title: No limit on choices
choiceFilling.detail: You can fill as many choices as you want and change them until you lock.

choiceFilling.title: Locking is compulsory
choiceFilling.detail: If you don't lock your choices within the scheduled time, you will not be considered for allotment.

choiceFilling.title: Locked means final
choiceFilling.detail: Once locked, choices cannot be altered.

choiceFilling.title: Research private colleges first
choiceFilling.detail: Get detailed information about any private college before adding it to your choices.

choiceFilling.title: How merit is calculated
choiceFilling.detail: MD/MS/Diploma merit includes in-service (PMHS) weightage. DNB and MDS merit is based on All-India NEET rank.

rounds.title: Free exit if you don't join
rounds.detail: If you are allotted a seat in Round 1 and do not take admission, you can exit with no penalty.

rounds.title: Upgrade up to Round 3
rounds.detail: If you took admission after Round 1, you can still participate for an upgrade up to Round 3.

rounds.title: Don't re-list your current seat
rounds.detail: When trying to upgrade, don't fill the seat you already hold. If you are allotted the same seat again, your previous allotment is cancelled.

rounds.title: Join your upgraded seat
rounds.detail: If you are upgraded and don't take admission in the new seat, the new allotment is cancelled.

rounds.title: Category seat conversion
rounds.detail: Unfilled reserved seats are converted in Round 3, as per the conversion order.

rounds.title: Stray round: who is excluded
rounds.detail: Candidates allotted a seat in UP counselling who did not join or who resigned cannot take part in the stray vacancy round.

rounds.title: Stray round: already admitted elsewhere
rounds.detail: Anyone admitted to a PG course anywhere in India through AIQ or another state's quota cannot take part in the UP stray vacancy round.

rounds.title: Stray round: register again
rounds.detail: Fresh registration with ₹3,000 is mandatory. Only these candidates are on the stray vacancy merit list.

rounds.title: Stray round: you must join
rounds.detail: If you are allotted a seat in the stray round and don't report and join, you lose your security deposit and are debarred from UP NEET PG/MDS counselling 2027.

documents.name: NEET PG-2026 / NEET MDS-2026 admit card
NEET PG-2026 / NEET MDS-2026 score card or rank letter
Marksheets of all MBBS/BDS professional exams
Permanent or provisional registration certificate (State Medical Council / MCI / DCI)
Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in UP format
documents.detail: Issued by a competent UP authority. EWS and OBC certificates must be issued on or after 01-04-2026.

documents.name: EWS income & asset certificate (Annexure-3 format)
documents.detail: Family's total annual income below ₹8 lakh in the stated financial year. The family must not own any of: 5 acres or more of agricultural land; a flat of 1,000 sq ft or more; a residential plot of 100 sq yd or more in a notified municipality; or 200 sq yd or more outside one. You must be a permanent resident and not belong to a caste notified as SC, ST or OBC. Valid for the financial year stated on it. Uses the Prapatra-1 format (office memo dated 14-03-2019) with your attested passport-size photo and full address (village, post office, police station, tehsil, district, state, PIN). Issued by the District Magistrate, Additional District Magistrate, City Magistrate, Pargana Magistrate or Tehsildar.

documents.name: Disability certificate from a designated centre (Annexure-2)
FMGE pass certificate and NMC/State Medical Council registration
documents.note: Inferred from the FMG eligibility criteria (p5). The admission list (p12) has only the registration certificate (item 8).

documents.name: Signed service bond agreement (Annexure-4)
documents.detail: Required if you take admission in a government medical or dental college. The brochure also says everyone admitted to PG courses signs a bond, so confirm with DGME if you're joining a private college. You bear the stamp duty. The bond form asks for your Aadhaar number, mobile, email, and permanent and temporary addresses.

documents.name: One set of self-attested photocopies of everything
documents.detail: Bring originals plus one self-attested photocopy set.

admission.title: Where to take admission
admission.detail: Complete admission and pay fees at the allotted government college, or at the nodal centre named in your allotment letter for private colleges.

admission.title: Miss the deadline, lose the seat
admission.detail: If you don't take admission by the due date, you forfeit the seat.

admission.title: Originals are mandatory
admission.detail: If you fail to produce originals, or if concealment or falsification is found at admission or later during the course, you lose your candidature and will face legal action.

rules.title: Resign in person only
rules.detail: Only admitted candidates can resign, in person, at the college or nodal centre where they took admission. Resignations sent any other way are not valid.

rules.title: Must be updated on the portal
rules.detail: The college or nodal centre updates your resignation on the NIC portal within the scheduled time. Only portal-updated resignations count.

rules.title: Miss a deadline and the next tier's penalty applies
rules.detail: Each resignation window closes 2 days before the next round's choice filling. If you resign after it closes, the next stage's rules apply. For example, a Round 1 admittee who resigns late loses the full security deposit.

rules.title: Debarment for leaving government seats
rules.detail: If you leave a government medical or dental college seat after the final round and before completing the course, you are debarred from the next academic session's admission process.

ladder.window: Up to 2 days before Round 2 choice filling starts (e.g. by 11:00 AM on 22-07-2026 if choice filling opens 11:00 AM on 24-07-2026)
ladder.fees: Free exit. Government colleges refund all fees except the admission fee. Private colleges refund tuition paid.

ladder.stage: After Round 2 (or a Round 1 admittee who missed the Round 1 deadline)
ladder.window: Up to 2 days before Round 3 choice filling starts
ladder.fees: Government colleges refund all fees except the admission fee. Private colleges refund tuition paid.

ladder.window: Up to 2 days before stray round choice filling starts
ladder.otherConsequence: No candidate is permitted to vacate a seat after Round 3. These penalties apply if you still resign.

ladder.window: Up to 2 days before stray round choice filling starts
ladder.fees: 50% of the tuition fee paid is forfeited.
ladder.otherConsequence: No candidate is permitted to vacate a seat after Round 3. These penalties apply if you still resign.

ladder.stage: After the stray round, or before finishing the course
ladder.window: Any time after the stray vacancy round
ladder.otherConsequence: If your deposit was already refunded you must pay it back, by demand draft in favour of the DG, Medical Education & Training, UP, Lucknow.

bond.appliesTo: Candidates in government medical or dental colleges must serve it; the brochure also says everyone admitted to PG courses signs a bond, so private-college candidates should confirm with DGME
bond.placeOfService: Service must be in Uttar Pradesh, as far as possible / as required outside metros: as a Senior Resident or contractual lecturer in a government medical college, or as a contractual specialist at a district hospital or community health centre run under the Medical & Health Department.
bond.note: Translated from Hindi p15 bullet 1: 'Candidates taking admission in Government Medical or Dental colleges are required to mandatorily serve the bond'; bullet 2: 'candidates taking admission in postgraduate courses are required to sign a bond agreement for compulsory service' (no sector). Left untagged so private-college applicants see it.

rules.title: Your certificates are held until the bond is served
rules.detail: All certificates you submitted at admission, including your MBBS/BDS certificates, and your PG certificates stay with the institution until you complete 2 years of service or pay the bond amount. The government has a first lien on all of them.

rules.title: Bond is released if no posting comes
rules.detail: If the government does not offer you a posting within 3 months of finishing the course, the bond is released.

rules.title: Late payment attracts interest
rules.detail: If you don't pay the bond amount in time, interest applies and it can be recovered as arrears of land revenue. You also bear the stamp duty on the bond.

rules.title: Stipend repayment for employed candidates on study leave
rules.detail: If you're employed and the government grants you stipend for 24 months to study, but you work for less than 24 months during the course, the proportionate amount is treated as stipend. You must pay the balance back on top of the security amount.
rules.note: The source clause is partly blank-filled and garbled. This is the best reading.

rules.title: If you don't serve, pay immediately
rules.detail: If you don't serve 2 years, you must pay the bond amount immediately into the specified Government Treasury. During the 2 years of service you are paid a stipend. The bond is governed by the Laws of India.

instructions: Email only the official address, with your name, registration no., roll no., All India Rank, contact no. and email ID. Emails without these may not be answered.
Queries already answered in the information bulletin will not be answered.
Court cases about counselling fall under Lucknow jurisdiction only.
Check dgme.up.gov.in and upneet.gov.in for the latest updates.

annexures.title: Annexure-3: EWS certificate format
annexures.description: UP Government income & asset certificate format (in Hindi) for EWS candidates.

annexures.title: Annexure-4: Service bond

gaps.title: Counselling schedule
gaps.detail: The brochure has no dates for registration, choice filling, results or reporting. Check upneet.gov.in for the schedule notice.

gaps.title: Seat matrix by speciality
gaps.detail: The number of seats per college and speciality isn't in the brochure. It's published separately.

gaps.title: Cutoff ranks
gaps.detail: Previous-year closing ranks aren't in the brochure, so we can't predict college or speciality chances from your rank yet.

gaps.title: Private college tuition fees
gaps.detail: The brochure says private colleges charge the government-fixed tuition fee but doesn't list the amounts.

gaps.title: List of government colleges and seats
gaps.detail: Only private colleges (via nodal centres) are listed. Government colleges and their PG seats aren't.

gaps.title: Who gets the deposit back
gaps.detail: The brochure says security money is refunded to "eligible candidates" after all rounds, but doesn't define who is eligible beyond the resignation rules.
